title: Action Plan For GenAI Security | Slides
description: The article outlines a comprehensive action plan for GenAI security, emphasizing the importance of establishing security governance, securing end-to-end infrastructure, protecting data, safeguarding the AI model, and ensuring secure usage through user training and incident response measures. Key steps include forming a governance team, implementing network security, using encryption, conducting model validation, and monitoring user activities.

title: Attack Surface Area | Gen AI Slides
description: The article discusses various types of attacks on generative AI models, including prompt injection, data poison attacks, data sources attacks, and direct attacks on the model itself, all of which aim to manipulate the model's outputs or degrade its performance. These attacks can lead to the dissemination of false information, biased outputs, and compromised model integrity, highlighting the need for robust security measures in AI systems.
